info.sub_name: 多益聽力與閱讀:中級班

description.sub_name: 多益聽力與閱讀:中級班
description.describe_ch: 本課程為針對中級聽讀程度之英語學習者，所設計之多益聽讀測驗準備課程。學生將於課程中學習多益測驗所需之聽力與閱讀策略、加強文法及單字學習技巧、並藉由課堂與課後練習熟悉多益測驗之題型與作答技巧。
description.describe_eh: This course is targeted at students with an intermediate level of English listening and reading ability. Students will acquire essential skills in listening and reading strategies necessary for TOEIC listening and reading tests, will enhance their grammar and vocabulary learning ability, and will familiarize themselves with TOEIC test format and test-taking strategies through practice tests.

targets.describe_ch: 1.學生能了解多益聽讀測驗考試重點
targets.describe_en: 1. Students will understand the construct of the TOEIC reading and listening test

targets.describe_ch: 2. 學生能使用批判性思考的技巧來分析聽讀測驗所需之相關策略並且並將其應用在多益聽讀測驗的情境
targets.describe_en: 2. Students can use critical thinking skills to analyze the best strategies to be used in a reading and listening test and further apply the strategies to the context of TOEIC  listening and reading tests.
